job_search_brief's identically named response fields are a frozen outward projection, NOT a legacy reader — deliberately outside the trigger paths. The four storage readers are all inside them: autofill_profile.typed_work_auth's legacy branch, the extension's dual-read (extension/content/autofill.js), the panel's workAuthForWrite (extension/panel/actions/pause.js) and Profile's legacy-on-edit bridge (frontend/lib/autofill-options.ts typedEntry, whose test file in frontend/lib goes with it). Also requires GET /api/settings/autofill clean. Trigger paths are DIRECTORIES, not files: extension/content/ was widened 2026-08-02 after the phase-2 split moved the dual-read out of agent.js, extension/panel/ was added after the panel's workAuthForWrite turned out to promote the legacy pair before the first typed pause-row write while the content-only path read green, and frontend/lib/ holds the Profile bridge since the 2026-10 Profile rebuild. A file-pinned path goes green on the next rename without the reader dying.

No current client writes one top-level work_auth set: the panel's pause row learns into work_auth_by_country[<the market /context names for its question>] (extension/panel/actions/pause.js), and Profile and Setup write work_auth_by_country and send no work_auth (frontend/lib/autofill-options.ts forSaving); Companion builds from before still write work_auth. extension/content reading the resolved profile.work_auth from /context is the design, deliberately outside the trigger paths. Then the release after has shipped; keep the legacy read in autofill_profile.work_auth_entries until no stored autofill profile holds a top-level work_auth (check settings/autofill.json and the autofill_profile Setting row).
No reader of jobs.location may remain (JobSummary still exposes only the old field), then op.drop_column.

Both absent triggers are met: the backend reads no `.market` (offers_eeo reads apply_in), and the frontend reads no `value.market` of the market setting (its other `.market` hits are a permit question's own market key, so the frontend pattern is the setting's value, not a bare `.market`). The release after this one has shipped (a sync peer that has not updated reads the stored `market` key). Then drop the `market` computed field from MarketSetting and from MarketSettingResponse.value in frontend/lib/types.ts. Keep the legacy {"market": X} read until no stored market blob lacks `home` (DB check on settings key 'market').
